Name: The Very Greatest Wizard In The History Of History

Innate.Name: Day's Bond of Friendship
Innate.Description: Your psychic bond connects your companions. When an ally makes a saving throw, they use the highest bonus for that saving throw across all allies.

Actions.Name: Signature Spell
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, you cast one of the following spells. You can't cast the same spell two turns in a row.

SubOptions.Name: Greater Fireball
SubOptions.Description: A bead of fire streaks to a point you can see, then explodes. Every creature of your choice within a 200-foot radius takes 5d6+30 fire and 5d6+30 radiant damage. A creature can expend a Legendary Resistance to only take the fire damage.

SubOptions.Name: Silver Claw Strike
SubOptions.Description: You brandish your silvered claws and strike. Make five melee spell attacks (+14 to hit) against any creature of your choice that you can see. On a hit, deal 6d10+15 force damage. Afterwards, teleport to any space you can see.

SubOptions.Name: Hands of Day
SubOptions.Description:
Two clawed spectral hands appear. Choose two of the following effects:
	-Make a spell attack against a creature (+14). On a hit, deal 5d8+10 force damage.
	-Restrain a creature of your choice until the end of its next turn.
	-Gain a +5 to AC and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

SubOptions.Name: Lesser Wish
SubOptions.Description: Cast any spell of 8th level or lower, ignoring material components.

Apex.Name: Fundamental Evocation
Apex.FlavorText:
You've taken some time at college to learn the fundamentals. Simple principles of evocation.

Many people have made the mistake of thinking that simple means stupid. Nearly as many make the mistake of thinking that fundamental means easy, obvious, or not dangerous.

Fundamental does not mean any of those things. Fundamental means: everything else in the world is built on *this*.
Apex.Description: When you take this Hero Action, every enemy in a 20-foot wide line emanating from you takes 300 force damage.
